versions.subject: Added experimental web 'shell_spawn' rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    - EventLog: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational
      EventID: 1
      ParentImage:
          - '*\w3wp.exe'
          - '*\httpd.exe'
          - '*\nginx.exe'
      Image:
          - '*\cmd.exe'
          - '*\sh.exe'
          - '*\bash.exe'
condition: selection
